title: COLOUR RUN 2026
description: TOMORROW WE RUN THE CAMPUS IN COLOUR! The countdown is OVER! Get ready for the BIGGEST, WILDEST and most ELECTRIC student experience of the season at the Cavendish University Zambia COLOUR RUN 2026! Expect NON-STOP vibes with live performances from Aqualaskin, Auorex, Gabby GT and other exciting artists. Featuring Ping Pong Battles, Pop The Balloon, Tug of War, Dance Offs, Musical Chairs, Sack Race, Mud Race and MANY MORE surprises! Wear WHITE, bring your squad!

title: Dev3Pack Web3 Hackathon 2026
description: The hackathon is open to students and recent graduates, with a strong focus on female participation. Tracks: Best apps on Solana, Best mobile apps on Solana Mobile, Best cross-chain apps using LI.FI Protocol, Best integration of ElevenLabs, Best AI agent in real environments. Prizes: $10,000 cash, Solana mobile phones, represent Zambia globally. Top 3 teams join Dev3Pack accelerator & pitch at Africa On-Chain Summit in July.
